summary: Rootcause2 product repair is implemented and committed in Alembic commit d019f1467efdd00b7408b4cde9c2aa9449af449d. RuntimeArtifactLoadReceiptV1 now recomputes canonical full-dist hashes for accepted archives and loaded Main/Core/Agent roots, recomputes Main embedded Core/Agent and Plugin embedded Core content, verifies actual Node package resolution converges on the same physical Core, and binds sanitized dist hashes/counts into the receipt. The finalized replay branch now awaits rejection before asynchronous cleanup, eliminating the intermittent unhandled STRICT_FINALIZED_PUBLIC_ROUTE_DIVERGENCE rejection. Status remains blocked exactly as required because the controller's accepted Main archive is the parent snapshot (sha256:e6c2360cda6d14f0dc81508d858d492a3d34c43b29a102433806dece3bc94cf8, 404 dist files), while this commit builds sha256:5aa4996da6610b95ac1a6da83df465104fb6b846e5b4eb5f2c6a8d4ac127d9ff with 408 files; the unchanged Bootstrap entrypoint hash alone is no longer accepted. The unmodified controller manifest now correctly fails closed with STRICT_RUNTIME_ARTIFACT_STALE_DIST. Controller must rebuild the exact Main artifact/manifest from this commit before acceptance.
